purpose: One ordered build plan for everything the six designs propose, so phase 2 can run in parallel lanes without two agents editing the same files.

authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: On 2026-10-12 the owner directed: "take this as starting point and deliver till end. Delivery this work with the AIWorks environment." The starting point is docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md (PR #12), with owner decisions D1, D3, D5 (direction only) and D9 recorded in its section 8. This campaign consolidates the implementation slices of the six merged designs into the plan's section 6 build order. Documentation only. Commits are published as PRs only: the supervisor never merges or deploys, and the live runtime, its data directory, the governance checkout and the scheduled tasks are never touched. No run cap or cost ceiling (AW-002); provider limits are waited out. Provider order Claude, then Codex.

constraints: Program netbka/aiworks#14: deliver docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md through supervisor campaigns. Change only the files your task names. Other campaigns change other files at the same time: never edit their files, other agents' branches or worktrees, or campaigns/*.json.

Your assigned worktree is the only place you change files. Never touch D:/Git/aiworks/.local (live runtime, supervisor data directory, governance checkout, other worktrees) or the main checkout, and never start, stop or restart the supervisor, its scheduled tasks or the dashboard.

No production access, deployment, GitHub Actions changes, paid services, Telegram or other provider API calls, or new recurring spend. Never read .env contents, credentials or secret files. Read Engineering Platform only with read-only gh commands; never write the governance checkout or open changes in another repository: EP-side changes are proposed as text.
Follow AGENTS.md: run npm ci once in your worktree, then npm run check after changes. Report exact commands and pass/fail tallies.

Never weaken an assertion, delete or skip a test, or broaden a timeout to make the gate pass. Tests make no model, network or GitHub calls: synthetic executables and disposable git repositories, as tests/supervisor/helpers.mjs does.

Keep AW-001 to AW-007 as written. Do not enable a power whose decision is still open (GitHub-free local admission, Auto Release, Telegram delivery): design it, or build it switched off, and name the decision it waits for.

Label every claim about the running system observed, verified, planned or unknown (AGENTS.md evidence rule); merged is not deployed. Do not comment on GitHub, merge, close issues or change labels: the supervisor publishes your verified commit. Write "Refs #N", never "Closes".
Write for the owner first: plain English, short sentences, the outcome before the mechanism. Link Engineering Platform policies instead of copying them.
Read GitHub with REST only (gh api repos/netbka/aiworks/issues/<n> --jq .body and .../comments), never gh issue view or gh pr view: the GraphQL quota is shared and has run out before (#16, #21).

tasks.title: Consolidate the six designs into one build order with lanes and file ownership
tasks.outcome: The plan says, in one table, what gets built in which order and lane, who owns which files, and what waits for an owner decision.
tasks.goal: Read the six merged designs in docs/design/ (PROJECT_CONNECTION, WORK_ENVELOPE, ADAPTIVE_SCHEDULER, MODEL_ROUTING, OWNER_WORKSPACE, AUTO_RELEASE), the open issues #16 to #33 (gh api, REST) and the merged state of main. Replace section 6 of docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md with one consolidated build order. Merge duplicate or overlapping slices across designs into one slice with one owner, and resolve contradictions between designs (state each resolution and its reason). Group the slices into 3 to 5 lanes that can run as parallel campaigns: within a lane slices run in order; across lanes no two slices may change the same file before the earlier one is merged (name the shared files and the order that avoids conflicts). For every slice give: id, one-line outcome, owned files, dependencies (slice ids, including the aw-foundation and aw-reliability tasks already declared), tests, and whether it waits for owner decision #24 (D2), #32 (D4) or #33 (D5-gate), in which case say what part is built switched off meanwhile. Put first the slices that remove today's operational problems (#18, #21, #27) and the one-slot limit, since they speed up everything after. Keep sections 1 to 5, 7 and 8 unchanged except for links.
constraints: Change only docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md section 6 (and its table of contents line, if any). Do not edit the design documents, campaigns/ or code. Do not invent slices the designs do not support; a gap you find is listed as a gap.
acceptance: Every implementation slice of the six designs appears in section 6 exactly once, or is named as merged into another slice with the reason; nothing is silently dropped (the PR lists the mapping design slice id -> build-order slice id).
No two slices in different lanes change the same file without an explicit order between them; the PR lists each shared file and the order.
Each slice that depends on #24, #32 or #33 says what is built switched off meanwhile and what stays off until the decision.
The first slices address #18, #21, #27 and the one-slot limit, or the PR says why not.
